I am a CTF player and a member of the C0mp13x_7he0r3m team, with a strong interest in Digital Forensics and Malware Analysis, continuously developing my technical and analytical skills in cybersecurity
When I'm not breaking things (ethically!), you'll find me creating tech content, playing chess, or diving into the latest security research papers.
I’m ready to verify that your system is operating properly, because every trace tells a story… and there is no perfect crime 🤫

projects.title: Sentinel Shield | Anti-DoS Protection System
projects.description: Sentinel Shield is an enterprise-grade Denial-of-Service (DoS) mitigation system designed as a transparent reverse proxy layer that sits between client traffic and a backend application. The system provides real-time threat detection, intelligent rate limiting using a Token Bucket algorithm, multi-tier IP isolation, and a full-featured monitoring dashboard — all deployable via a single command using Docker.

projects.title: History of Algeria Database using Dynamic Data Structures
projects.description: A hybrid C/Python project that models a historical database for Algeria using dynamic data structures and exposes the functionality through a Flask web bridge.

projects.title: Linux Audit Project
projects.description:
NSCS Mini-Project - 2025/2026 [S1] OS

This is a bash script that checks hardware and software info on Linux. It works on local machines and can also check remote ones via SSH. It saves reports as text and json.

projects.title: securec v2
projects.description: securec v2  is a semester project for the NSCS module on Algorithms and Static Data Structures. It is a C-based security utility suite that combines user management, audit/security analysis, encryption, log management, and math/security helper tools.
